### Description

`Ellipsis` is a builtin type that `pydantic` does not support. Its usage is infrequent, but it can be useful to express placeholders:

This is a bit of a contrived example, but:
```python
class Model(pydantic.BaseModel):
    m: list[list[float]]
    subset: tuple[int | Ellipsis, int | Ellipsis]

    def subset_arr(self) -> np.NDArray:
        return np.asarray(self.m)[*self.subset]
```

Here's how I implement this right now with an adapter: https://github.com/psalvaggio/scientific_pydantic/blob/main/src/scientific_pydantic/ellipsis.py

However, since this is a standard library type, I think this would be a good thing to live in `pydantic` itself.


### Affected Components

- [ ] [Compatibility between releases](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/changelog/)
- [ ] [Data validation/parsing](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/concepts/models/#basic-model-usage)
- [ ] [Data serialization](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/concepts/serialization/) - `.model_dump()` and `.model_dump_json()`
- [ ] [JSON Schema](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/concepts/json_schema/)
- [ ] [Dataclasses](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/concepts/dataclasses/)
- [ ] [Model Config](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/concepts/config/)
- [ ] [Field Types](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/api/pydantic/types/) - adding or changing a particular data type
- [ ] [Function validation decorator](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/concepts/validation_decorator/)
- [ ] [Generic Models](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/concepts/models/#generic-models)
- [ ] [Other Model behaviour](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/concepts/models/) - `model_construct()`, pickling, private attributes, ORM mode
- [ ] [Plugins](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/integrations/dev-tools/mypy/) and integration with other tools - mypy, FastAPI, python-devtools, Hypothesis, VS Code, PyCharm, etc.
